entities.summary: Aleksandr Shumidub was a Belarusian ice hockey player and manager. Shumidud played in the Soviet Hockey League and the Russian Superleague for HC Dinamo Minsk. He competed in the men's tournament at the 1998 Winter Olympics for Belarus.
